text:
maya: Quick check — bringing up lagoon13b (FP16 -> int8 hybrid). Seeing ~18% token cost reduction vs fp16 but a worrying longform recall drop. Cutting cost ~3.2x. Need quick guidance for GTN/product on routing and holdback.

sam: can you paste the smoke numbers (latency/throughput + quality samples)?

maya: bench snippet below:
```
fp16 baseline: cost_per_token = $0.012, p95 latency = 160ms, acceptability = 0.78
int8-hybrid: cost_per_token = $0.0037, p95 latency = 180ms, acceptability = 0.63
delta recall: -12% (8k long context), -3% (512 short)
kv-cache hit: ~82% on our trace
```

alex: Oof. 12% longform recall loss is high. What's the primary failure mode? hallucination, omissions, shorter outputs?

maya: Mostly omission / truncated completeness on multi-step reasoning chains. Hallucinations not major. Prompt-amplification reduces gap a little.

tyra: For GTN: product target is ~90% of current quality on flagship flows. 0.63 vs 0.78 seems too low. My recommendation: keep int8 for low-cost background and low-risk routes; keep fp16 for critical user-facing flows.

sam: +1. Proposed quick traffic split sketch: let shortform + non-critical = int8, longform/creator workflows = fp16. Maybe 70/30 int8/fp16 but shift more to fp16 for >2k tokens.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started lagoon13b-int8 in us-west with 1 GPU. Metrics pipeline: https://internal/dash/model/lagoon13b/int8

maya: tried a hybrid where attention q/k run in fp16 and rest int8 — recall improved ~5 percentage points, cost increased ~20% vs int8.

tyra: If hybrid gets us to -7pp longform that might be acceptable with prompt engineering and gated rollout. We need a short scorecard for GTN to sign off.

alex: I can run a 2k-user A/B with labeled slices. Will spin microbench and signal evaluation.

maya: uploading 200 sample slices now to eval harness. ETA ~6h.

sam: also include token-econ delta in the scorecard. quick calc: avg tokens per req = 300.
```
# quick calc
fp16_pp = 0.012
int8_pp = 0.0037
avg_t = 300
delta = (fp16_pp - int8_pp) * avg_t
# delta = $2.49 per request
```

tyra: Good. If a quality hit reduces conversion by ~5% for critical flows, $2.49 savings per req might be a net negative. GTN needs to give conversion sensitivity numbers.

maya: Drafting scorecard fields: [model_variant, cost_per_token, p95_latency, recall_long, recall_short, acceptability_delta, recommended_route]. Will populate after eval.

alex: Rollout gate suggestion: require recall_long >= -8pp and no >2pp hallucination increase. Otherwise holdback.

tyra: I'll sync with GTN + PM. If microbench passes, propose mixed fleet: int8 default for non-critical, fp16 pinned for flagged routes, hybrid for mid-tier traffic, with auto-fallback.

maya: noted, will run evals and post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: ping me when results are in, I'll prepare routing flags and cost sims.

ops-bot: alert: eval job finished (200 samples) — results available: https://internal/redwood/evals/lagoon13b/int8/200

maya: quick summary from eval results: long_recall = -9pp, hallucination = +0.6pp, overall acceptability drop = 6pp. Hybrid variant recovers to -4pp with ~1.6x cost vs int8 (still ~1.9x cheaper than fp16).

tyra: Based on this, proposed action: 1) Mixed fleet: int8 default for non-critical; 2) fp16 pinned for creator/longform flagged routes; 3) hybrid for mid-tier flows. Draft RFC for traffic splits and thresholds.

alex: Add monitoring: rolling eval on production slices and automatic rollback if acceptability drops >4pp over 24h. Also instrument priming sensitivity metric.

maya: created ticket INF-2314 for canary + eval + routing flags. Will attach the eval CSV and sample failures.

sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

tyra: Thanks team — I'll draft the GTN note and proposed split (including cost sims) and loop in PMs.

maya: will post final scorecard when available.

(small notes: we used a 200-sample quick eval — results are noisy, need larger A/B to be decisive)
